description: This file is a shell script used to rewrite revision history in a Git repository. It provides functions and procedures to apply various filters to commits, trees, and references, facilitating complex history rewriting tasks such as filtering subdirectories, remapping commits, and updating tags. The script includes mechanisms for state management, user warnings, and detailed progress reporting.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an original commit ID to a rewritten ID if available, otherwise returns the original.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by outputting its parent commits, used to omit specific commits during rewriting.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree has changes; otherwise, skips the commit.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Sets and exports author and committer identity variables from commit metadata.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer information from a commit and sets related environment variables.
